readerCopy.summary: The institution responsible for enforcing the limit faces the people who believed its promise of care.
readerCopy.body: The institution responsible for enforcing the limit faces the people who believed its promise of care. Officials point to law, budget, eligibility, and what can be documented; recipients and workers point to need, prior assurances, and the human cost of withdrawing support. Saturn holds the formal boundary, while Neptune gives the unfulfilled ideal a voice that cannot be reduced to a failed application. The opposition places institutional reality across from the compassionate story used to build trust. The program may survive the review, but its credibility does not if care only existed while nobody was asking what it cost.
